review_brief:
# Review aa1306d02a4eddf1

Both assigned bases were repaired where the bounded review found concrete teaching/control defects, and both now include complete native parametric families with exact canonical defaults.

## e282a664f807 — repaired, ready for owner review

The base sampler now exposes strict meaningful rectangle controls and guarantees both corner slopes in every two-example lesson window. The native alternate completes all two-cell candidates, selects the unique largest completed rectangle by area, and recolors it to 9. Its retained wrong-order Racket program selects before completion, when all candidates are tied at two raw cells.

## 67c14e0f76b1 — repaired, ready for owner review

The base palette schedule was repaired after a repeated-palette four-example window survived review. The parametric teaching prefix was also repaired after a first-marked shortcut survived three demonstrations. The native alternate applies the canonical gap-marking rule, then recolors the unique largest newly marked component to 8 on setting-neutral inputs; the wrong-order Racket program selects a raw blue component first and changes the result.

## Evidence retained

- 22 focused tests per target in the final source state.
- 64-seed bounded audits per target: 128 episodes and 896 labelled pairs; no retained named-rival survivor.
- `67c14e0f76b1` additionally checks 256 base lesson windows.
- Protected authoring preflight per target: four jobs and 40 Racket evaluations.
- Protected intended-versus-wrong-order causal replay per target.
- Sixteen one-query public projections per target with privacy and first-turn invariance checks.
- Substantive 30x30 query cases in both families.

These are authoring preflights, not owner qualifications. Exact integrated-source owner review, native qualification, fresh acceptance and any training admission remain pending. Final code review was author-side because this environment provided no independent reviewer/subagent facility.

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The original grid with several vertical four-connected components of newly marked color-2 cells, one uniquely largest.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Apply the canonical local rule, changing each zero with immediate blue neighbors on both horizontal sides to color 2.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Find the unique largest newly marked color-2 component in that intermediate and recolor all of its cells to 8.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The cells selected by Stage B are background before Stage A, so their marked components and sizes do not exist in the raw input; choosing a raw blue component first destroys one side of some gaps and changes the result.
